en: Black-and-white postcard view taken from the sea, showing a coastal town with low buildings along the waterfront and steep hills rising behind it. A large multi‑storey waterfront building stands on the left, while smaller houses stretch along the shoreline to the right. The water occupies the foreground. Greek text is printed in the bottom border, along with a French translation of the location and a photographer's credit. A web address is faintly visible across the lower right area of the image.
